text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Haaa, haaa, haa……!! 
Aww man,
I ran out of energy part way again……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've been doing so much stamina
training…… 
no, this isn't the time to be complaining!
The 『Oaks』 
is soon so I need to work hard……!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey. ……You already realized it, right? 
About Kraft-san.

(I already knew. The longer the distance,
the harder it would 
be for Kraft. The 『Oaks』,
at 2400m……would be very difficult)

(Based on that,
I believed the best option for Kraft…… 
would be to offer her another option……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……I really admire them. 
My senpais on the Triple Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I'm choosing the Triple
Tiara rotation. And,
I'll become strong enough that 
I won't lose against Triple Crown Uma
Musume!

(Admiration can be the driving force
behind chasing your dream. Without that,
it would be 
like taking away your entire reason for
running)

(Considering how much Kraft admired the
Tiara……it might 
be too much to ask her to give up on the
『Oaks』――)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As you continue to run,
sometimes the shape 
of your dreams will change……or perhaps
there's 
no choice other than for it to change.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, they never disappear. 
If you never give up,
never let go――that's for certain.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the one that understands that
the most? 
……since you've been walking this path with
me this whole time.

Right……think.
Don't just dismiss it out of hand, keep 
thinking it through.
What can I do for Kraft right now……?

Right……think.
Don't just dismiss it out of hand, keep 
thinking it through.
What can I do for Kraft right now……?

(Kraft is……a girl that admires the Tiara
Uma Musume more than anything. Then,
who would 
know best what to say to Kraft right
now――)

text_block_list.name: Telecaster
text_block_list.text:
『"The Unparalleled Queens"――Tonight,
we'll be speaking about 
the magnificent tales of the top Senior
Class Queen Uma Musume』

Several Queen Uma Musume who had etched
their 
names in to history were shown on screen.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
――It could be said that it was 『Overturning』
expectations. 
The revival of a dynasty by my Grandmother,
and my mother who won two tiaras.
As one descended from their blood――

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As the successor to a "Renowned Family" who
had 
many expectations to achieve the Triple
Tiara. 
That I was unable to accomplish it is
reality.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Being unable to participate in the 『Oka Sho』,
and a late start 
during the 『Oaks』.
Being forced to recuperate during the
autumn.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
……On top of that,
my aptitude lying in short distances.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As you're aware,
compared to the royal road that is medium 
distances, there is much less attention.
There were a great 
number of voices of disappointment when
switching. However――

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
What I recieved from my mother and my
grandmother, was this 『Speed』.
In that world where we compete for 
those instants, short distance,
I ran to prove myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That this path――is my duty, that this 
place is where my passion can shine.

Daiichi Ruby.
Winning the 『Yasuda Kinen』 and 
『Sprinter's S』,
an Uma Musume that proved the 
strength of her bloodline through her
『Speed』.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
――I don't believe I possess any outstanding
qualities or talent. 
Unlike everyone else here,
I never achieved victory in a G1.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However,
if it's something that I take pride in, 
then I do have that.
My strength was achieved through 
the information gained from those around
me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My 『Intel Skills』 are what I take pride in,
my weapon. 
In the racing world,
filled with such strong individuals, 
to truly shine――this is my weapon.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To go just a bit farther.
For one more battle. 
And――to obtain just one more bit of glory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With this weapon, my 『Intel Skills』,
I will accomplish that. 
……I am proud to do this on my own will.

Ikuno Dictus. In the Twinkle Series, 
competing in 51 races without injury――

With a grueling 3-week rotation of the
『Yasuda Kinen』 and 『Takarazuka Kinen』.
An Uma Musume with a body and 
mind of steel who still managed to achieve
2nd place in both.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
――Getting a flashy title like 『Unparalleled
Queen』, huh? 
Honestly,
I never thought of anything complicated like
that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The only thing I seek is to compete against
the strong! That's all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A lukewarm battle,
does nothing to fire up my soul.
For this body, 
for this heart,
it can't be anything but a fierce race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Something that pushes me closer and
closer to my limits――no,
a race that forces me past 
my limits,
that's when I become the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I'd get asked if I've ever felt 
intimidated, you know? But never,
not once. 
Rather,
it's so fun I can't help but get excited!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It was like that when I faced off against
that "Monster" too! 
I'm the strongest when I'm fighting it
out!!

Hishi Amazon.
Although she wasn't able to participate
in the Oka Sho or Oaks,
she had won 5 consecutive major victories.
Then she went on to win the Elizabeth
Cup――

Not only was she considered the queen of
her generation, but with her strength,
she was the only one to come even 
close to that "Monster", Narita Brian,
at the 『Arima Kinen』.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――My mother once held the title of "Queen".
From my first steps…… 
or maybe even before that,
my path was already decided.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To become the brightest guiding light.
To become the 『Ideal』 
for all Uma Musume,
for all those who are just beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is my mission. 
To become that "Empress" is my reason for
existence.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In which case,
I have nothing to fear.
No matter which battlefield―― 
whether it be the 『Tenno Sho (Autumn)』 or
the 『Japan Cup』.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will move forth with dignity,
putting all of my 
strength, all of my being,
in to obtaining victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To continue taking on all those challenges
will be the 
way to inspire all those that come after――I
think that 
belief is what spurred me on to greater
heights.

Air Groove.
She became the first Uma Musume from the 
Tiara route to win the 『Tenno Sho (Autumn)』,
becoming 
an inspiration for many famous Uma Musume
after her.

Staring at the screen,
I racked my brain. Keep thinking. 
These amazing Uma Musume who carved their
names in to 
history, what did they all have in common?

Each of them had their own dreams, goals,
and missions, 
alongside a strong desire to pursue them.

Wondering where they could shine the
brightest. 
Understanding their true strengths.

Thinking, worrying, choosing. 
And then――

(……deciding their own unique path for
themselves. Something 
they could be proud of and achieving glory
along the way)

Just like the Triple Crown Uma Musume,
they built an 
era. Leaving a wide impact on many,
even if they weren't 
considered the representatives of their
generation.

But those Tiara Uma Musume still had an
appeal all of their own.
And――they had already shown 
us that.
They had shown us and created that link.

(That's why……Rhein Kraft was here 
right now, why she was running.)

The program had ended before I realized.
I turned off the 
TV and took a deep breath.
The room was completely silent, 
the only thing on my mind――was the cheering
at the 『Oka Sho』.

I was now convinced.
The place that Rhein Kraft 
could be the strongest,
shine the brightest was――
(Knock knock……)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Excuse me……Ah, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Good afternoon. Um,
well then……by important 
conversation, what did you mean?

I tried not to sound too cold,
but wanted to give my honest opinion.
Due to her aptitudes, 
the 2400m Oaks would probably be incredibly
difficult.
Therefore, as a trainer――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh……eh? By different, you mean……?

……your run at the 『Oka Sho』 was really
amazing. When it comes to Mile races,
I think you're the 
fastest of your generation……that's what I
believe.

……your run at the 『Oka Sho』 was really
amazing. When it comes to Mile races,
I think you're the 
fastest of your generation……that's what I
believe.
That's why……Kraft.

Just give it some thought Kraft.
And about your aspirations, 
your dreams,
and what you've seen so far along your
journey.

Just give it some thought Kraft.
And about your aspirations, 
your dreams,
and what you've seen so far along your
journey.

And then…… 
about a path that only you can run.

And then…… 
about a path that only you can run.
